strategy.offer: Premium cured and cooked meat products, including sausages, ham, pâtés, aspic items and organic options for deli counters and refrigerated self-service shelves.
strategy.customers: Butcher shops, grocery retailers, supermarkets, wholesalers, and consumers looking for dependable, high-quality deli and chilled meat offerings.
strategy.why_we_win: It combines inherited recipes and craftsmanship with modern manufacturing, carefully selected ingredients, and rigorous quality standards to deliver reliable enjoyment and product safety.
strategy.resources: Longstanding know-how, skilled processing expertise, proprietary seasoning know-how, large-scale maturation and production facilities, and certified quality, organic, and energy-management systems.
strategy.direction: Continue modernizing traditional production, expanding ranges including organic lines, and increasing customer transparency about how products are made.
